# The Lean Berets

> > Historical kinesiologist Ron Jones and team revive classical physical education methods, including the legendary LaSierra PE program, through restorative movement, calisthenics, and brain-based fitness.

The Lean Berets promotes "Avengers of Health" philosophy by teaching forgotten PE methods from the 1950s-60s, featuring equipment like Indian Clubs, Health Wands, and SandBells. Led by Ron Jones, MS, the organization documents Stan LeProtti's famous LaSierra High School program and offers coaching, podcasts, and educational resources on movement restoration.

## Key Topics

- LaSierra High School PE Program
- Stan LeProtti & Monteen LeProtti
- Ron Jones (Historical Kinesiologist)
- Classical Physical Education
- Restorative Movement
- Calisthenics & Bodyweight Training
- Indian Clubs & Health Wands
- Brain-Based Movement
- Bonnie Prudden Myotherapy
- Military Fitness Preparation
- Posture & Structure Correction
- World Calisthenics Organization
- Natural Method (Georges Hébert)
- Functional Movement Systems (FMS)

- [Resources by The Lean Berets](https://theleanberets.com/approved-resources): Restorative Movement guides, gear tips, and resources by Ron Jones
